common.title: Arktik — custom software, built in the open
common.description: A software studio in Indonesia. Leave the building to us — the price agreed before each stage, and everything in your name.

header.banner: You talk to the engineers, not an account manager

hero.description: Leave the building to us, so you can run the business instead of the project. The price is agreed before each stage starts, working software arrives every week, and the code and every account are in your name from day one.

aboutUs.quoteText: 95% of new products miss the mark — not because of the idea, but because of poor execution
aboutUs.quoteSource: MIT Professional Programs: Why 95% of New Products Miss the Mark
aboutUs.mainDescription: Software rarely fails on the idea. It fails on execution. Execution is a process problem, and process is the part we are strict about.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.description1: A small studio in Indonesia building custom software for businesses that have outgrown their spreadsheets and off-the-shelf tools.
whoWeAre.description2: We keep the team small deliberately. It is the only way the person who planned your project is still the person building it three months later.

howWeWork.title: How we think
howWeWork.description1: Openly, and in writing. The reasoning behind a decision is worth more a year later than the decision itself.
howWeWork.description2: We would rather tell you something is a bad idea early than build it politely and watch it fail.
howWeWork.description3: Agreeing each stage up front means you can stop after any of them without an argument.

collaboration.title: Proven technology
collaboration.description: Widely used, well-supported tools. The interesting part should be your product, not the technology we picked.

expertise.title: Reasons written down
expertise.description: If we cannot explain why we did something, we have not finished the work.

impact.title: Small and senior
impact.description: No layer between you and the person writing the code.

innovation.title: Honest estimates
innovation.description: We quote what the work costs, not what wins the deal.

customDevelopment.title: Web and mobile applications
customDevelopment.description: Things people use every day — customer portals, booking systems, internal systems, online shops. Built on proven, widely used technology, so the next person to work on it can pick it up quickly.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: A review, a second opinion, or a plan. Useful when you already have a team and need to know whether what you have will hold up, or what to build next.

aiAutomation.title: Automation and AI
aiAutomation.description: Taking the manual work out — handling documents, sorting requests, summarising, internal assistants. If a spreadsheet would do the job, we will say so.

design.title: Product design
design.description: How it looks and how it flows, for things that actually get built. Delivered as real working screens, not a PDF.

operations.title: Running it after launch
operations.description: Hosting, monitoring, fixes, and the small changes that come up once real people are using it. For teams who would rather not take that on. Priced monthly, cancel whenever, and the accounts stay in your name throughout.

mainCard.title: Small on purpose.
mainCard.description: You get the people who did the pitch. Nobody is swapped out after signing and nothing is subcontracted — so it is one conversation, not a chain of them.

globalExperience.title: Seven years inside product teams
globalExperience.description: Before this studio we spent seven years building and shipping product at established technology companies. That is where the process on this page comes from.

endToEnd.title: We stay if you want us to
endToEnd.description: Plenty of clients would rather not run it themselves, and we are happy to — hosting, support, and whatever comes next, agreed the same way as everything else. The difference is that you are choosing it, not stuck with it.

tailored.title: We say no
tailored.description: If an off-the-shelf tool solves your problem, we will tell you and point you at it. Custom software is expensive and it should be the right call.

proven.title: Built to be handed to someone else
proven.description: Proven tools, conventional structure, and the reasoning recorded alongside the code. Whether the next person is your team, another studio, or us in a year, nothing depends on what is only in someone's head.

contact.title: Tell us what you're building.
contact.description: A few sentences is enough to start. The first step is a call to work out what you need — no charge, no sales deck — and you can stop there with the plan in hand.

works.title: Selected work

cta.title: Start small.
cta.description: The first job does not have to be the whole product. Pick the smallest thing that is genuinely costing you — one process, one connection between systems, one screen people fight with. We agree what it takes, build it, and hand it over. If that went well, we do the next one.

works.subtitle: Agreed, delivered, and handed over in full — the code, the accounts, and every password in your name. Some clients take it from there. Others keep us running it.

lenggah.description: Bilingual website for Lenggah, a custom furniture and interior design studio: filterable portfolio, process, and a consultation form.
lenggah.summary: Lenggah is a custom furniture and interior design studio. We built its site for one job: getting a prospective client confident enough to ask for a consultation. Every part of the page leads to the form and the WhatsApp button.

mata-screen-print.description: Website for a screen printing shop in Bekasi (t-shirts, jackets, tote bags): catalogue with starting prices, per-piece estimates, and a quote form.
mata-screen-print.summary: Mata Screen Print is a screen printing business in Bekasi for t-shirts, jackets, and tote bags. People ordering printing want two answers before they get in touch: roughly what it costs, and what the result looks like. The site answers both on the first screen.
built: A service catalogue with a starting price per product
A per-piece price estimate table with minimum order quantities
A portfolio gallery of finished work
A quote request form: product, quantity, a link to the design file, and notes on sizes or deadline
A WhatsApp button with a pre-filled message

serenity-cove.summary: Serenity Cove Resort is a landing page for a beachfront boutique resort. The focus is atmosphere: an asymmetric layout, large photography, and animations that play as you scroll, without hiding what guests look for, such as suite types and prices.
built: An asymmetric layout with scroll animations
An amenities section: spa, pool, restaurant, fitness centre
A suite catalogue with size, amenities, and nightly price
A guest experiences section and a reservation call to action

mulia-consulting.description: Bilingual website for an Indonesian HR consulting and talent solutions firm, built around booking a free HR strategy audit.

aion-tulungagung.summary: A design concept for a licensed AION sales agent in Tulungagung. The client's brief was a single desktop page. We developed it into a full site that also works well on phones, filled with sample data until the client's official prices and details arrive.
built: A home page, four model detail pages, promotions, gallery, and contact
A credit simulator that works out the instalment on the page, then sends the result to the sales WhatsApp. No visitor data is stored
A mobile layout and an always-visible WhatsApp button
AutoDealer and Car structured data for local search

details.ctaText: Tell us a little about your business. The first step is a free call to map out what you need.

process.title: How we work
process.description: Four stages, each agreed before it starts — so the only thing you ever have to decide is whether to keep going.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: We work out the real problem, who uses it, and what limits us — before anyone writes code. You end up with a written plan and a fixed price, and it is yours to keep whether you continue with us or not.

design.title: Design
design.description: We decide how it looks and how it is built, together. You review real screens in your browser, not slides.

build.title: Build
build.description: Delivered in pieces you can actually use. A working demo every week, and a private link you can open any time — you don’t have to watch it being built, you just always can.

handover.title: Handover
handover.description: The code, the documentation, and every password and account are confirmed as yours. From here some clients run it themselves and others keep us on to do it. You are choosing which, and that is the whole point of doing the first three stages this way.

scope.title: Agreed before we start
scope.description: What you get and what it costs are put in writing before each stage begins. No renegotiating halfway through.

ownership.title: Everything ends up yours
ownership.description: The code, the servers, the domain, and every account are in your name from the first day — not ours.

access.title: Talk to the people building it
access.description: You deal directly with the people writing the software. Nobody relays messages on our behalf.

products.title: Our products
products.subtitle: Besides client work, we build and run products of our own. Same process, except the client is us.
products.label: Arktik product

jejakSaham.tagline: Who is buying into, adding to, trimming and exiting stocks on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
jejakSaham.description: An ownership tracker built on public KSEI and BEI filings. Daily ownership changes of 5% or more and monthly changes of 1% or more, across about 963 listed stocks, 5,663 holders and 40 mapped business groups.

ayoMain.tagline: A catalog of Indonesian-language games for kids aged 2–10. No sign-up, no ads.
ayoMain.description: HTML5 games curated one by one and grouped by age. Kids play straight away on a phone or laptop; parents get clear information for every game. Game makers can submit their work to be reviewed and published.

jelita.tagline: Salon software: online booking, stylist schedules, point of sale, and commissions in one app.
jelita.description: Customers book themselves from the salon's page, stylist schedules stay in order, and the till works out commissions and deducts stock at checkout. Runs in the browser on phone and laptop, free for single-branch salons.

jejakSaham.metaTitle: Jejak Saham: IDX stock ownership tracker | Arktik
jejakSaham.metaDescription: An Arktik product that tracks who holds, adds to, trims and exits stocks on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, from public KSEI and BEI data.
jejakSaham.tagline: Who is buying into, adding to, trimming and exiting stocks on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
jejakSaham.intro: Jejak Saham reads the ownership filings KSEI and BEI publish every trading day and puts them in one place: who holds what, when their stake changed, and which business group sits behind it.
jejakSaham.featuresTitle: What you can do with it

moves.title: Ownership moves
moves.description: Every reported change: holders coming in, adding, trimming or exiting.

stock.title: Stock pages
stock.description: Major holders, the history of their stakes, and free float for each stock.

investor.title: Investor pages
investor.description: One holder's portfolio across every stock filed under their name.

groups.title: Business-group map
groups.description: The member stocks of each group, plus an ownership network graph you can explore.

screener.title: Screener
screener.description: Filter stocks on ownership data and fundamentals together.

financials.title: Financials and valuation
financials.description: Income statements drawn as a diagram, plus historical valuation for each stock.

backtest.title: Backtests
backtest.description: See how a screen would have performed historically before you rely on it.

watchlist.title: Watchlist and Telegram alerts
watchlist.description: Follow the stocks and portfolio you care about and get notified when ownership changes.

jejakSaham.tiers: There is a free tier and a Pro tier.

moves.alt: Daily ownership moves list in Jejak Saham
moves.caption: Ownership changes of 5% or more in one trading day.

screener.alt: IDX stock screener in Jejak Saham
screener.caption: The screener, with ownership and fundamental filters.

financials.alt: Income statement flow diagram in Jejak Saham
financials.caption: An income statement as a flow diagram, from revenue to net profit.

jejakSaham.built: Built and run by Arktik on Next.js and Postgres. Data pipelines ingest the public KSEI and BEI publications every trading day and map each holder to its stocks and business group.
jejakSaham.disclaimer: Jejak Saham is not investment advice. It is not affiliated with BEI, KSEI or OJK.
jejakSaham.ctaTitle: Need a data product like this?
jejakSaham.ctaDescription: We build systems that turn public or internal data into a tool people use every day. Tell us what you need.

ayoMain.metaTitle: Ayo Main: Indonesian-language games for kids | Arktik
ayoMain.metaDescription: An Arktik product: Indonesian-language games for kids aged 2–10, curated one by one. No sign-up, no ads, no personal data from children.
ayoMain.tagline: Fun games for little ones, picked one by one.
ayoMain.intro: Ayo Main brings Indonesian-language HTML5 games for kids aged 2–10 into one place. Kids just tap and play, with no account and no ads. Every game is checked before it goes live, including games submitted by outside makers.

accounts.label: accounts or personal data from kids

catalog.title: Catalog by age
catalog.description: Games are grouped for ages 2–4, 5–7 and 8–10, with clear game types.

parents.title: Information for parents
parents.description: Every game has a page covering age, how to play, ads and children's data. Parents can also subscribe to new-game updates by email.

noSignup.title: Play straight away
noSignup.description: No sign-up and no app to install. Games run in the browser on phones and laptops.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.description: Some games can be added to the phone's home screen and played without internet.

creators.title: Game maker programme
creators.description: Adult game makers can sign up, upload a game as one ZIP file and follow its status. Their name appears on games that go live.

review.title: Queue and review
review.description: Submissions enter a queue, are checked automatically, get a recommendation with reasons, and are decided manually by the team.

sandbox.title: Sandboxed games
sandbox.description: Games from makers run separately from the site, with no access to cookies, site storage or the internet.

popular.title: Popular and newest
popular.description: The catalog can be sorted by most played or newest. Plays are counted without storing anything that identifies a device.

ayoMain.tiers: Free for families and for game makers.

cover.alt: Ayo Main home page with the colourful block logo
cover.caption: The home page: play straight away, no sign-up.

catalog.alt: Ayo Main game catalog with age filters
catalog.caption: The catalog, with age filters and sort options.

detail.alt: Parent information page for the game Warung Meong
detail.caption: Information for parents: age, how to play, offline, ads and children's data.

maker.alt: The game maker page on Ayo Main
maker.caption: The game maker page: sign up, upload, then join the review queue.

ayoMain.built: Built and run by Arktik on Next.js and SQLite. Every submitted game is first played in an isolated browser with no internet access, its code is scanned, and it is assessed with AI assistance. The result is a recommendation; the decision to publish stays with the team.
ayoMain.disclaimer: Ayo Main asks children for no account and no personal data, and shows no ads. Game maker accounts are for people aged 18 and over.
ayoMain.ctaTitle: Need a content platform that is safe for kids?
ayoMain.ctaDescription: We build products with curation, moderation and privacy from the start, from the catalog to the review flow. Tell us what you need.

jelita.metaTitle: Jelita: salon booking, POS, and commission software | Arktik
jelita.metaDescription: An Arktik product: salon and spa software for online booking, stylist schedules, POS, commissions, stock, and payroll. No install, free for one branch.
jelita.tagline: A full book, and a calm head.
jelita.intro: Jelita puts a salon or spa's daily work in one place. Customers book themselves through the salon's page, the front desk sees every stylist's schedule, and the till works out commissions and deducts stock on the spot. Owners follow revenue and reports from their phone.

roles.label: owner, admin, front desk, and stylist

booking.title: Online booking
booking.description: Every salon gets its own page with services and prices. Customers pick a service, a stylist, and a time without an account or an app.

schedule.title: Stylist schedules
schedule.description: Daily and weekly calendars per stylist, with working hours and breaks. Double bookings are refused up front.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.description: Charge from an appointment or a walk-in, by cash, transfer, QRIS, debit, or credit. Receipts are numbered and cashier shifts are recorded.

commissions.title: Automatic commissions
commissions.description: Stylist commissions are calculated when payment completes, following rules per service or per staff member.

customers.title: Customer records
customers.description: Visit history, notes, and contact details in one place, searchable and exportable.

stock.title: Product stock
stock.description: Stock goes down on its own when a product sells, with a low-stock flag.

payroll.title: Payroll and reports
payroll.description: Pay and commission summaries per period, a finance overview, and CSV exports for the owner.

branding.title: Salon colors and logo
branding.description: The booking page carries the salon's own logo and colors, not Jelita's. Works across more than one branch.

jelita.tiers: There is a free plan for single-branch salons. Plans for larger salons are arranged on request.

landing.alt: Jelita's home page: online booking, point of sale, and commissions for salons
landing.caption: jelita.arktik.id: sign up free for a single-branch salon.

today.alt: Jelita's Today dashboard for a sample salon
today.caption: Today: revenue, stylist capacity, and the agenda. Data from a sample salon.

calendar.caption: Daily schedule: every stylist gets a column.

pos.alt: Jelita's point-of-sale screen with services and products
pos.caption: Point of sale: services and products, five ways to pay, commissions worked out on the spot.

salon.alt: A sample salon's page on Jelita with services, prices, and branches
salon.caption: Salon page: services, prices, opening hours, and a booking button per branch.

jelita.built: Built and run by Arktik with Next.js and Postgres. The rules that matter, such as schedules that must never overlap and transactions that cannot change once settled, are enforced in the database itself. Time always follows the salon's time zone.
jelita.disclaimer: The screens on this page use a sample salon with made-up names and data. Automatic WhatsApp reminders and online payment at booking are still in development.
jelita.ctaTitle: Need an operations system for a service business?
jelita.ctaDescription: We build everyday tools for appointment-based businesses, from booking to the till and reports. Tell us what you need.
